glossEn: the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
note: the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement。中性义：「有条件做某事」。线索：ability to do sth，宾语是动作。I have the ability to solve this problem.

glossEn: possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
note: possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done。强调「具备的素质/天赋」，尤其心智能力。线索：talent / aptitude for sth，宾语是领域。She has real talent for music.
